routes.title: Peccioli: art through the historic centre
routes.duration: About 2 hours (official tourism framing; field-test for final)
routes.access: Mostly public exterior; individual museum/palazzo/church stops vary
routes.stops: Welcome to Peccioli → Fessura e Contravvento II → Endless Sunset → Chiassi a fil di luce cluster → Azzurro → Palazzo Senza Tempo cluster → Colonna che scende → Flower Up

routes.verification: Field-record walking path, slopes, steps, lift dependency, night-time visibility and exact dwell time.

routes.access: Public exterior, with optional oratory/VOCI stop

routes.verification: Confirm all stop positions, street access, safe walking order and photo/traffic issues.

routes.title: Palazzo Senza Tempo and the valley

routes.stops: Photo-souvenirs A 45° → Rotating Mirror IX → Dai su fammi un sorriso… → Lane → Colonna che scende → Lo sguardo di Peccioli
routes.verification: Confirm current Palazzo opening/access rules and whether each work is visible without entry.

routes.title: Legoli and Belvedere: art, landscape and infrastructure
routes.distance: TBD after verified driving / walking trace
routes.stops: Rilievi → Centrifugo → Belvedere plant cluster: Presenze / All’altezza delle margherite / Triangolo Verde / Untitled-Germoglio / Gabbiani

routes.verification: Confirm booking flow, visitor parking, safety constraints, route sequence and which works are currently viewable.

routes.verification: Test booking process, audio delivery, access permissions and availability for every stop.

verification_queue.request: Capture exact visitor-safe GPS coordinate, entrance/approach, map orientation and a reference photo for every flagship work.
verification_queue.why: Do not publish false pins in a dispersed museum.

verification_queue.request: Create a media rights matrix: owner, creator/photographer, permitted formats, credit line, expiry and territory.
verification_queue.why: Public online display is not a published reuse licence.

verification_queue.scope: Plant, churches, palazzi, cinema and hotel works
verification_queue.request: Confirm current visitor access, booking requirements, seasonal closures, visible-from-public-space status and contact point.
Confirm official title, artists, commission/date, exact site, access, approved text, imagery and rights; publish only after it appears in institutional catalogue or is signed off.
verification_queue.why: It is externally reported but absent from current official MACCA index used here.

verification_queue.request: Confirm official Italian title, artist credit, year, materials/technique, dimensions, project/commission and display status.
verification_queue.why: Public sources are strong for basic facts but inconsistent for technical metadata.

verification_queue.scope: Titles and dates flagged in inventory notes
verification_queue.request: Resolve current-title variants (e.g., LUX work title; Chiacchiere provenance/year; Et fugit title variant) using source-of-truth institutional record.
verification_queue.why: Avoid duplicate or contradictory public records.

verification_queue.request: Walk/drive each proposed route with GPS logging; record distance, elapsed time, slopes, steps, lighting, toilet/water/parking options and detours.
verification_queue.why: Prototype durations are editorial estimates, not final navigation data.

verification_queue.request: Confirm booking pathway, audio files/transcripts, author credits, language availability and permission to publish extracts.
verification_queue.why: The route should be genuinely audio-first, not a static list.

verification_queue.request: Approve authoritative bilingual titles, artist credits, summaries and accessibility descriptions.
verification_queue.why: Avoid literal or inconsistent translations across website and QR pages.

verification_queue.request: Assign an editor and define a recurring update workflow for new works, maintenance closures, seasonal notices and temporary changes.
